## Problem or motivation

A clear description of the problem you're trying to solve or the use case you want to support. Example: "I'm always frustrated when ..."

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or change you'd like. Be as specific as you can (APIs, behavior, examples).

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional context

Relevant context: framework area (core C++, Python bindings, platform, frontend), constraints, or links to similar features in other projects.
